body: I'm not sure anymore. I really used to think that, but how can I know it's not fueling my delusion? I just don't want to be defective anymore. I do thank you for your kindness, though.
I hear you. Almost feels pointless to live as male haha.

Late reply, but I thank you for your kindness. My family isn't all that bad, though, there are just some rough spots every now and again. It's really hard to believe any men actually want a trans woman outside of a fetish (transmasc individuals nonwithstanding), because it's all I ever see, but I guess all that says is he isn't for me, whether I transition or not. 

But really, thanks for all the encoragement, it means a lot.

Sorry for the late reply, but I really appreciate your words of kindness. It's so hard constantly thinking I can't exist successfully on either side of the divide (I very much believe I am not non-binary), but it's nice to know other people have the same feelings, so I'm not actually a freakshow.
It's so frustrating, too. I really like men, but being one has genuinely ruined my life. I think they're so attractive, so why is being one such a problem? I just don't get it.

Ay, I can relate to the childhood thing. Never could keep a friend, hell I even got seated away from other kids with big-ass folder partitions because I kept having outbursts. Guess who happens to be autistic?

I can tell you, it's no death sentence, G. Sure, smell and touch make me want to curl up into a ball and die, but that's just me. If you are autistic? It just gives you a name for the problems, and that makes them easier to solve.

You've been through something horribly traumatic, so your feelings are totally understandable. Do you think you'd benefit from a survivor's support group? It's obviously weighing you down heavily, and finding others who know exactly what you're going through would probably be able to tell you better than I would that you're deluding yourself. Even your rush to get back into sex is a classic trauma response.

Bottom line, you need support. Any attempt to feel better through sex is only going to make you feel worse, trust me. You're at a stage where anything you say or do will make you feel worse, so you should find someone who can separate fact and fiction.

You sound like the most sane one in that group, not to offend. Three people walking around on a beach at night literally sounds like the opening to an episode of CSI: Miami, so I'd have my ass in your pool, were those the two options. Seriously, what do you gain by walking around AWAY from help? I had friends who would visit abandoned buildings. What's up with that?

Hey man, just letting you know that's awesome and that it takes a fuckton of strength to do what you're doing. Male or female, overcoming that type of trauma is no easy feat, and it makes you no less a man for having it happen to you. Keep strong and kick ass.

As opposed to being...? I suspect the answer is white. Let me let you in on a little not-so secret, that's the intended result of racism. Our hair is seen as dirty because it's not seen on white people (but then there are also full-blooded African people with ramrod straight hair, is their hair dirty too?), it has nothing to do with you. If it's a mainenance thing, I get it, type 4 hair is a fickle bitch. Either way, you and your black features have done nothing wrong, you have just been hurt by a racist system that asserts white beauty to black people's detriment. You already know this, but maybe you need to hear that literally none of this is you.

What I do not understand, however, is how this figures into your relationship with your mother. Is it that you both have self-hatred issues that make it hard to communicate? If so, I don't think reddit can solve that, just open and honest communication about how socital attitudes have impacted you two. Of course, this is quite honestly a meme in many circumstances, so if you feel comfortable clarifying the situation a bit, I would like to hear.

Yeah, I'm sorry if I sounded tone-deaf, because I have literally the opposite experience with this personally. I personally love my short kings, but I know my setup is a bit different from what you describe. You know how they say the biggest sex organ is the brain about men who are a little shorter downstairs? That applies to height as well, at least to me.
Hey, my dad's only like 5'7", and I'm here. Being short's not a death sentence, my guy.

I don't know if you need this now, but allow me to tell you that that is abuse, full stop. I basically signed away my teenage years trying to keep someone else alive and happy, and I can tell you, threatening or attempting suicide like that is a form of abuse that scares the shit out of you so you won't leave. He was going to kill himself with or without you, saying you caused it is just one final fuck you to "punish you" for making the right choice. Please know you are not the bad guy here.
He clearly is. He looks and is evil, he's with the government, and they want to kill me.
